steps.name: Stained Fairy Tale (1)
steps.objective: First, talk to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」, and then go to [Talos] in 「Knossos」.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Welcome, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found the item and gave it to the person in Luman. I think I can find it in a similar way this time... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you figure that out? Did you find out that such items can be found?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's not a secret, I just don't know. how… It's difficult to say.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I think I came to know this because I stayed here for a long time and received information through spirits.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: If you're really curious, how about staying here for a few hundred years?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm curious, but for some reason I don't want to.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I thought you would.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where should we go this time, Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Of all the places you've visited recently, which place leaves you with the most questions?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Knossos… It was the territory of the Beastman Empire a long time ago. It seems like a lot of things happened there, but nothing I could tell.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, by any chance… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You went to Freios and Eastland before Arche came here. So… . Have you ever been to Knossos?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm not sure. I went, but I don't remember, or I didn't have it at all... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It reminded me of when I was a weaver, but not entirely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Still, I'll think about it as much as I can. Even if not right away... If this helps %s... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry, Arche. I was just thinking about myself.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No. Just give it a try. I think I might find out something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Then, I will go straight to Knossos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Talos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Since you came so suddenly, I guess you came because you wanted to find out something from me.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: If I wanted to build trust, I told him to come visit me often and he listened well. The goddess's motherfucker.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whoa, let’s hold on. Let’s wait.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came because I wanted to ask you something.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Bare mouth? Let's help each other. If you want something from me, show your cards too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What is this?
(Talos takes the envelope from %s and looks puzzled.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I passed the guard post and came here to pick up trash. I also pulled some grass.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Damn… . Doing what I love the most... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: If you go that far, I will listen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems surprisingly easy...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we'll talk. Have you lost anything recently?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: No, there isn't. Okay then? Go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There, there. Wait a minute. Or even a person looking for a lost item.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I haven't lost it recently, but there is something I want to find. It's hard to say it's mine... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I know what it is... Ah, Narsha!)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you don't have it, you can't do it.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It seems like it's too easy to understand, doesn't it? Have you decided where to go?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'd like to ask how it feels to save the world, but that would be obvious. The world will continue to face a crisis of collapse. I don't know what you'll do, but I'm excited?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I might be in it too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please keep saying it one more time.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You don’t really want to do it right now? Next time, one trash bag won't do.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Go see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, I can't help it. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Have you been there… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Phew… . I thought you were here because of witches, but I guess you weren't. Still, we have no choice but to be careful... .

steps.name: Stained Fairy Tale (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Kairos] in 「Time of Kairos」 and obtain <Storybook: Witch and Golem>. Go to the dungeon reward room and check the situation, then report the quest to [Theodore] in “Guild Alliance City Esnil.”

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, welcome!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How are you, Narsha? Nothing much happened, right?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, nothing special. Teacher, no, Adventurer, I don't think anything bad has happened these days because you care about me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you going to stop calling me teacher?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh, that… . I got scolded.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To whom?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uh… . The president.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: He told me to call it that only when I was properly taught. sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, it's okay. Is it okay to talk now?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I like talking. But what's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you lost anything recently or are you looking for something?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: There's nothing lost, there's something I'm looking for. It’s a book… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it a book?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This is a book containing stories that my mother, my sister, told me when I was young.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can I hear what the story is about?
(Narsha closes her eyes and begins to remember.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's not exact, but that's what it said. A child was walking in the forest and got lost. Then I met a golem and played with it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: A bad fairy appeared in front of the child who had been playing with him for several days.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The fairy said to stop playing with the golem and go back to where it came from. The golem said it would be better for the child to go with the fairy rather than stay here and sent the child away... .

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: So I think it was a story about a golem being left alone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…Ai and Golem….)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: As I was looking at my situation these days, that story suddenly came to mind... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think of Narsha and the magic golem, and also the story of Bergelmir and Eda in Oneiro Forest...)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: This story is an oral tradition that most people in the Sylvaria Empire, including here, know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I inquired at the Belpar library, but they said they don't have this book. Although it was published, it was so long ago and there were only a few copies, so it would be difficult to find.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is that the book…?)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I will look for it too. There's a place I go back and forth these days... . Don't expect much though.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you for your words, teacher. no… , Adventurer!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: If you find the book later, please give it to Uncle Theo. I thought it would be a good idea for you to check.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. I have a place to go, so I'll go. See you later.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You must be busy, but thank you for coming.
(As Narsha is happy, Madori, the magic golem on her shoulder, also seems to be moving excitedly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I go to Kairos, will I be able to find the book? . Hmm, I have no choice but to go first.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Haaam… . I'm sleepy.
(Kairos, who was sleeping face down in front of the tree right in front, wakes up and rubs his eyes. No, he rubs them.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I found out what was flowing in here.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I heard about it from Arche, but it's a hassle. So what is that thing?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's a book about the friendship between a golem and a child.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Like a storybook?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: How did you find the item where Kronos is?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They said it had flowed into a deep realm and that I had to get ‘permission’.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Like that?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Is this it?
(Kairos takes out a book from his arms and shakes it.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I fell asleep for a long time without thinking, and the book fell from the tree.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, great. give it to me I'll take it out.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: But what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no way… .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I need permission. It was supposed to have flowed into the deep realm, but seeing it here means something must have gone wrong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I'm so glad I don't have to explain it too long. It was annoying... . It's annoying to me too, but we have to spar. Got it?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Good luck finding the way, I'm on my way.
(Kairos yawns and jumps up the tree.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel sleepy too... . I want to sleep… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. Then shall we come to our senses and go?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: End of sparring.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it done now?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Here's a book.
(Kairos takes out a book and hands it to %s.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I just gave it to him coolly because it was different from the owl watch. This may also be the moment of your important choice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do you say it's important when all you're doing is getting a book?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: That’s… .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Actually, I don't know either. I said that because I am the spirit in charge here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's an occupational disease.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: That's kind of it. What kind of book is this about? I had it, but I didn't see it... .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It's written in human language, right? Do you want to read it to me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh. I was also curious about the contents. It's not very thick, so you'll be able to read it quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s see, the title of the book is… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “The Witch and the Golem”, the Witch and the Golem?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Wait, %s!! Don't read books here!
(Kairos is surprised and snatches the book from %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It can get complicated... . Gaia wouldn't want it, and the being who gave 'permission' wouldn't either.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: If you want to read it, please read it in the presence of humans.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Take care from now on. Because I don't know what will happen. ruler.
(Kairos hands the book back with a worried expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos. This book.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you saying that someone deliberately planned this book to come here?

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: I don't know that much. Anyway, you have to be careful. I don't know what will happen next.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: … You can't let a fateful moment go awry. And don't miss the moments you think are important.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kairos, I'll go. Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: Yeah... . Wow.
(Only after the trace of Adventurer disappears from the realm of time, Kairos takes a slow step forward. Then, he looks at the sky of time with lonely eyes as if he remembered something.)

lines.speaker: 카이로스
lines.text: It seems like the time that Gaia was worried about is coming through the cracks... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Theo.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Ah! Are you here? I'm sorry. There's something I was thinking about for a moment... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: But what happened?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I found the book Narsha requested. Narsha told me to give it to Theo... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Oh, really? Will you give me that book?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. here… .
(Theodore takes the book, looks through it, and cannot continue speaking.)

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: This is an old story that many people, including me, know. Oh, I don’t know because you’re a foreigner… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard it briefly from Narsha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A golem appeared in front of a child who was wandering in the forest, and while they were playing together, a bad fairy appeared and told them to stop playing with the golem and go back... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: That's almost accurate. This story probably changed little by little as it passed through the mouths of many people.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Contrary to Narsha's expectations, this book seems to contain almost the original content... . Disguised as a fairy tale... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It's not long, so I'll explain it briefly.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Before and after Sky of Chaos, Freios has changed a lot. The war resulted in a struggle for hegemony, and in the process, many powers rose and fell.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Among them, it wasn't just humans. Human greed has also taken advantage of other beings.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Oh, don't tell me this story somewhere else. It's kind of like a taboo... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: The child is not lost. He ran away. He didn't meet the golem and play with it, but instead avoided the golem that was attacking him as much as possible.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Fairy tales are expressed through playing together... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is a bad fairy?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Witch… .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: There is a witch in Freios. It's different from the demon women of the demon world. They rarely show themselves, but those who do live their lives doing their own thing.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: In my view, the child in this fairy tale is a gift to save the village from witches... , no, it looks like a sacrifice.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: The golem must have been created by a witch. It must be like a gatekeeper preventing a child from escaping. On the surface, it seems like a fairy tale about the friendship between a child and a golem... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: This is just a witch's story... . Maybe there was something the witch wanted from the child.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: For example, you wanted this child to become a witch, or you recognized a child who was already a witch... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is also that interpretation... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Why was Narsha curious about this book?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I just honestly wanted to know. From the magic golem he carries with him to his identity... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You must have a lot of worries... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It must have been because a lot has happened recently. Phew… . I will keep this book. I'll talk about it to Narsha later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please do so. And if anything happens to Narsha, or to anyone here, please let me know right away.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: You must be busy with your work, is that okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Thank you… . If you need my help, feel free to come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll just leave. See you later, Theo.

lines.speaker: 태오도르
lines.text: Go carefully.
(Adventurer leaves and Theodore, who is looking at the book again, stops looking at the last page.)

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Hmm, what is this letter written on?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Is this a cipher text used by the Empire a long time ago? First, I'll have to try a combination.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: To Hilda… ? Hilda… , Is this a person’s name?
